member.name: T:LsdeDialogEngine.Newtonsoft.LsdeJson
member.summary:
JSON loader for LSDE blueprints using Newtonsoft.Json. Recommended for Unity projects (com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json).
The polymorphic block converter is gone: v2 has ONE Block whose optional fields depend on its Type, so there is nothing left to dispatch on while reading. That is also why the engine reads camelCase JSON only — the naming policy below already does the conversion, and renaming keys inside the payload would corrupt the three bags whose KEYS are the game's own data: Text, Props and Args.
